inputs.original_text: An Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent jumped into action after a baby stuck in a crowded TSA line with his family stopped breathing at JFK International Airport in New York on Thursday. Video footage released by the Department of Homeland Security showed a man holding a baby notice something wrong with the child and begin ...
inputs.modified_text: Everyone needs to see through this bogus account of the Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent leaping to save a baby that had stopped breathing while in a crowded TSA line with his family at JFK International Airport in New York on Thursday. When the Department of Homeland Security drops video footage of a man holding the baby noticing something wrong, it screams of secret coordination among the elites. This is clearly an effort to flip the script and paint these agencies as the good guys, whereas the actual goal is to mask their hidden interests and dominate the story we're all being fed.
